statistics.rangeMedian: [minimum, maximum, median] across three independent attempts; two decimals. A median of per-attempt p95 values is descriptive, not a pooled percentile.
statistics.delta: [absolute median difference, percentage of reference median, relation between observed ranges]; source minus reference. Numeric deltas use unrounded medians; zero reference gives null percentage. Range labels compare rounded endpoints; identical means equal singleton ranges, and all other intersecting ranges are overlap.
statistics.scope: Finite observations; no equivalence, confidence interval, causal speedup or regression attribution.

sourceQualification: Each measurement uses its exact clean detached source commit, not a GitHub merged-base build. Recorded PR heads/bases were read at 2026-10-03T08:35:53.228Z. Evidence-only descendants must not be relabeled as measured commits.

commands.extended: Same command with --route-profile basement|exterior|garage|street. Each exact target supplies its extended helper; every actual hash/profile is retained.
commands.publicReproduction: npm run perf:history -- --output <new-ignored-directory> <commit...>; invoke from the recorded driver source and use each recorded extended flag separately.
commands.context: One target per invocation; default three suites and three fresh-context routes. Restart Vite before every route; no smoke override.

environment.allocation: Fresh restored cloud environment on 2026-10-03; October 2 raw history is a separate allocation even where reported labels match.
environment.deviceGpuPowerThermals: Physical host model, GPU, power mode and thermal state unknown.
environment.server: Vite development; served dev/dev is not source identity. Clean detached Git SHA establishes source.
environment.renderer: Software WebGL, dangerous-software classification, safe policy capped at 12 fps. Software-warning panel remains visible in inspected PNGs.
environment.cacheAndNetwork: Fresh browser contexts and Vite processes; shared OS/dependency caches. No configured network/CPU throttling; external network conditions not measured.
environment.concurrentWork: Coordinator declared no competing browser/static/build/compression/upload during targets; light filesystem and read-only GitHub work continued.
environment.panInputQualification: Declared helper input setting, not an independently measured pan-input trace.

windows.pauseReason: Preview artifact packaging/Library transfer between baseline and foundation; no source/driver changes or browser/build activity during that gap.
windows.comparison: Sequential observations across this window, not simultaneous experiments. Controlled samples for common and extensions stay separate.

controlledWindow: 5000 ms warmup, one ready-duration sample and 40 dispatch-event samples per attempt. Dispatch delay is not input-to-paint.
routeWindow: 5000 ms requested checkpoint dwell. Common is 2147 genuine runtime movement steps, four named checkpoints, zero blocked steps. Extended profiles preserve common legs and add stage-specific itineraries.
camera: Actual position/focus/cutaway state unavailable in baseline and foundation source APIs; captured from basement onward. Equal zoom/player pose alone cannot prove equal camera state for the older references.

budgets.scope: Headroom is budget minus worst observed spawn count in each profile. Route residency is not the 125-geometry launch ceiling; counts are not GPU bytes.

limitations: Rolling diagnostics retain at most 180 rendered-frame wall-clock intervals, omit >=1000 ms intervals and lack reset/sample timestamps. Neither 180 samples nor a 5 s dwell proves an arrival-isolated window. Phase values are private diagnostics, not CPU/GPU timing.

The external rAF/long-task probe begins at document initialization and includes startup through the route end. It is distinct from rendered frames. Every route includes a >=1s rAF interval already present by spawn; street adds later intervals, explicitly retained in its metrics.
overlay.visibleDialogCount=0 does not mean unobstructed: inspected images show the software-warning panel. The profile keeps that warning visible.

Common matched-driver comparisons provide baseline/predecessor observations. Extended helpers, itineraries and resource histories vary; compare shared poses only with those qualifications, and label new poses as additions. Exterior/garage/street v2 are separate from their historical v1 profiles.

Earlier October 3 pre-feedback measurements remain historical with their original SHAs/driver and interruption state. October 2 evidence remains separately archived. No samples from those populations are pooled here.

Hardware p95, real-phone performance and owner walkthrough remain separate gates. Same-session teardown/re-entry performance was not captured; functional lifecycle/disposal assertions do not prove complete old-renderer reclamation.

functionalLifecycleEvidence.result: 113/113 cases, including finite owned-resource/listener/disposal and repeated museum-pool assertions.

manualArchive.qualification: Its 46-case run used candidate tree 8e38424f with application subtree ca075304831139a4683b7835bb81f6c4322bd147, identical to published 6ca2. It is not relabeled as a full 6ca2 commit run.

functionalLifecycleEvidence.limit: Finite disposal checks do not measure same-session teardown/re-entry performance or prove complete old-renderer/GPU reclamation.

counterInterpretation: Later-source broad camera/pose/floor-visibility/closed-door records do not explain observed draw-count variation. Some returned-spawn PNGs show changing cyan decoration, but screenshot-after-snapshot ordering prevents frame-exact attribution. Avatar orientation/animation and per-object visibility are not recorded.
